name: Emergency and control room
description: For cockpit, control-room and dispatch traffic: status, commands, read-backs, warnings and plans under pressure.

detectors.name: Status report
detectors.what: the speaker reports the current state or a reading of a system or situation
detectors.example: Engine two is showing zero thrust.

detectors.name: Command
detectors.what: the speaker gives a direct command or instruction to act
detectors.example: Turn left heading zero two zero.

detectors.name: Acknowledgement
detectors.what: the speaker acknowledges or repeats back an instruction
detectors.example: Roger, turning left zero two zero.

detectors.name: Request for information
detectors.what: the speaker asks for a status, position or information

detectors.name: Warning
detectors.what: the speaker warns of danger or urges caution

detectors.name: States a plan
detectors.what: the speaker states what they intend to do next
detectors.example: We're going to try to land in the river.

detectors.name: Stand by
detectors.what: the speaker asks someone to wait or stand by

detectors.name: Uncertainty
detectors.what: the speaker expresses uncertainty, hedges, or says they are not sure
detectors.example: I'm not sure, maybe it was Tuesday.
